title: Concept: API version disclosed in the payload
description: An apiVersion field in a response payload in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The field pins the exact API build, and paired with a known changelog it tells an attacker which defects that build still carries.
applicability: Deployments that render an apiVersion field in a response payload into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The field pins the exact API build, and paired with a known changelog it tells an attacker which defects that build still carries.
